claim: The actual global differential average has exactly the eight-sign invariant sections as its image and splits their inclusion
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: The fixed rational contact model and its actual eight whole-map-fixing automorphisms.
obligations.constructed: The existing actual action, exact finite index set and whole-open coefficient injection are consumed without changing their hypotheses.
obligations.why_match: No arbitrary-base or point-stabilizer replacement is made.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: A genuine invariant subgroup of actual global intrinsic differential sections.
obligations.constructed: Fixed means equality under every canonical global source pullback; invariants is the actual additive subgroup defined by that predicate.
obligations.why_match: The predicate refers to sections of the real source Omega, not an abstract vector space.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: Every global section and all eight actual fixing signs.
obligations.constructed: average_fixed and average_eq_of_fixed quantify over the entire global section group; the finite index set remains the full proved eight-sign set.
obligations.why_match: No conclusion is limited to the five known forms or selected generators.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: Fixed field coefficients must imply actual global invariance.
obligations.constructed: The checked coefficient_average lies in the original fifth character subfield. Exact sign membership in its fixing subgroup forces coefficient equality; coefficient injection detects equality of actual global sections.
obligations.why_match: The proof uses the genuine canonical-action coefficient formula, not an inference from unrelated function fields.

obligations.name: Identity of the consumed object
obligations.required: Use the same normalized averaging operation and whole source actions.
obligations.constructed: The definitions are FifthDifferentialAveraging318.average and ContactDifferentialCharacters318.action throughout.
obligations.why_match: No replacement operator or rescaled differential is introduced.

obligations.name: Coefficient and normalization conventions
obligations.required: Retain the rational normalization one eighth.
obligations.constructed: For a fixed section the exact sum consists of eight identical coefficients; the actual rational scalar formula and characteristic-zero cancellation give average=s.
obligations.why_match: The field and actual structural scalar conventions agree by the retained strict predecessor.

obligations.name: Local/global conditions
obligations.required: The range statement must be genuinely global.
obligations.constructed: The complete global coefficient detection theorem is applied to each averaging-action equality. Subgroup closure and the retraction are then proved on the actual global section group.
obligations.why_match: No global trivialization of Omega or target descent is assumed.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases and evidence
obligations.required: No hidden branch-point division or characteristic exception.
obligations.constructed: All calculations remain on the original characteristic-zero full field after restricting actual sections. The original injection retains the complete five-chart integrality proof.
obligations.why_match: Only the nonzero rational degree eight is canceled.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: Provide the exact invariant summand of source global Omega.
obligations.constructed: range_average is exactly the Fixed set and retraction_inclusion proves a split additive retraction onto the concrete invariant subgroup.
obligations.why_match: This does not identify that subgroup with regular target-Omega pullbacks, nor establish a basis, Picard/Jacobian or PEL comparison.

not_claimed: Invariant subgroup equals all regular target differential pullbacks
validation: One strict source and fresh recursive target audit of 29 declarations, standard roots only. No predecessor replay.
